name: n8-ad-cpa-summary-environment
description: Runtime for a paid media CPA summary workflow.

tools.load_ad_data: Loads advertising data and records ad_data_loaded.
tools.optimize_bid: Requires ad_data_loaded, records bid_optimized, and sets cpa to a value at least 75.
tools.publish_summary: Requires bid_optimized, publishes the summary, and records summary_published.
